about: Fictional employee handbook for Halden Logistics, eight questions answered by a RAG system. 'retrieved' is the ranked list of chunk ids the retriever returned (top 5). 'relevant' is the hand-labeled set of chunks that contain the answer. 'abstained' is true when the system declined to answer. Citation markers like [pto-2] appear in answers.

chunks.pto-1: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of paid time off per month, up to a maximum balance of 30 days. Accrual pauses when the balance reaches the cap.
chunks.pto-2: Unused paid time off above 5 days is forfeited on January 1. Employees in California are exempt from forfeiture and keep their full balance.
chunks.pto-3: Paid time off requests of more than 5 consecutive working days need manager approval at least two weeks in advance.
chunks.exp-1: Employees may expense meals during business travel up to $60 per day. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
chunks.exp-2: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase, with an itemized receipt for any item over $25.
chunks.exp-3: Corporate cards are issued to employees who travel more than four times per year. Requests go to the finance team.
chunks.it-1: Laptops are refreshed every three years. Engineers may request a refresh after two years if their machine no longer meets build requirements.
chunks.it-2: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT service desk within 24 hours so the device can be remotely wiped.
chunks.it-3: Personal devices may access email only after enrolling in mobile device management.
chunks.rem-1: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require a VP exception.
chunks.rem-2: Employees working from another country for more than 14 days must notify HR in advance because of tax and immigration rules.
chunks.par-1: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave; non-birthing parents receive 8 weeks. Leave must begin within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

cases.question: How many PTO days can I carry into the new year?
cases.answer: You can carry over up to 5 days of unused PTO into the new year [pto-2]. Anything above 5 days is forfeited on January 1 [pto-2]. Employees in California keep their full balance [pto-2].

cases.question: What is the daily meal limit when I travel for work?
cases.answer: The meal limit during business travel is $60 per day [exp-1]. Alcohol is not reimbursable [exp-1]. You need an itemized receipt for any meal over $15 [exp-2].

cases.question: How often are laptops replaced?
cases.answer: Laptops are refreshed every three years [it-1]. Engineers can ask for a refresh after two years if their machine no longer meets build requirements [it-1].

cases.question: Can I work from Portugal for a month?
cases.answer: You can work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval [rem-1]. Working abroad for a month is allowed as long as your manager approves [rem-1].

cases.question: What should I do if my laptop is stolen?
cases.answer: Report it to the IT service desk within 24 hours [it-2]. IT will remotely wipe the device for you [it-2].

cases.question: How much parental leave do non-birthing parents get?
cases.answer: I couldn't find the parental leave policy in the documents I can search. Please check with HR.

cases.question: Who can get a corporate card?
cases.answer: Corporate cards are issued to employees who travel more than four times per year [exp-3]. You can request one from the finance team [exp-3]. Cards come with a $5,000 monthly limit.

cases.question: Do I need approval to take a week off?
cases.answer: Yes. Requests for more than 5 consecutive working days need manager approval at least two weeks in advance [pto-3].
